mapper.insert: insert into environment_build_submission(tenant_id, actor_id, idempotency_key, environment_id, command, request, build_id) values (#{tenant}, #{actor}, gen_random_uuid()::text, #{environment}, jsonb_build_object('repository', #{repository}::text, 'branchName', #{branch}::text), '{}', #{build})
insert into platform_user(id, tenant_id, username, display_name) values (#{reader}, #{tenant}, #{reader}::text, #{name})
insert into asset_user_grant(tenant_id, user_id, asset_id) select tenant_id, #{reader}, asset_id from asset_build_member where tenant_id = #{tenant} and build_id = #{build}
insert into asset_build_scope(tenant_id, build_id, environment_id, repository, branch_name, indexed) values (#{tenant}, #{build}, #{environment}, #{source}, #{source}, true)

insert into deployed_asset(tenant_id, asset_id, owner_id, environment_id, repository, branch_name, kind, node_id, dimension_name) values (#{tenant}, #{asset}, #{owner}, #{environment}, #{source}, #{source}, 'METRIC', concat('metric.', #{source}::text, '.product_count'), '')
insert into asset_build_member(tenant_id, build_id, asset_id, query_name, selector) values (#{tenant}, #{build}, #{asset}, 'product_count', '')
